question: How should the preferences of younger investors shape Edward Jones's offerings?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones has launched a new digital platform initiative focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.
items.quote: and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones took a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, intending to integrate Quicken's personal financial management capabilities into Edward Jones to support its value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken , with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones as a way to support their value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.

items.text: Edward Jones's initiatives include targeting new clients including High Net Worth and Workplace, and a new digital platform for Next Generation investors.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth, focused on attracting and serving high net worth clients through expanded advice, planning, products and services across multiple service models; Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones's strategic ambition includes anticipating clients' needs with the right offering at the right time, now and for generations to come, and attracting and serving new client segments.
items.quote:
Anticipate clients' needs with the right offering at the right time, now and for generations to come

• Attract and serve new client segments

items.text: Edward Jones cites generational wealth transfer and changing client demographics, preferences and values as strategic risks it seeks to address through its initiatives.
items.quote: most notably competition for clients and personnel in light of the evolving financial services industry and generational wealth transfer, changing client demographics, preferences and values

cells.reason: Passages describe Edward Jones's own disclosures and initiatives (Next Generation digital platform, Quicken investment) but provide no comparison to competitors' disclosures/initiatives for younger investors.
